movie.title: Komšije
movie.description: A married couple from Belgrade decide to move from the city to the countryside so they can work on both their marriage and their careers as artists.

movie.title: Srećni ljudi
movie.description: Glavni junaci u seriji su članovi porodice Golubović (otac, majka, njihov sin, sinovljeva žena i njihovo dvoje dece). U vreme sankcija i teškog života, ova porodica suočava se sa problemima u svakodnevnom životu. Svako je prinuđen da se snađe na svoj način.

movie.title: Koreni
movie.description: The story of fictional Katić family. Vukašin returns home from the studies in France to tell his father Aćim and brother Đorđe that he plans to marry the daughter of his father's political opponent and enemy. Aćim threatens to wipe him out from the will and intricate family relations come to light. Đorđe and his wife have problems, because after 15 years of marriage they still have no children.

movie.title: Radio Mileva
movie.description:
The comedy "Radio Mileva", directed by Elmir Jukić, is based on the idea of ​​Nebojsa Garić.
Mileva is the head of the house, she knows everything, she knows everything and she understands everything. A pensioner who spent her working life as a secretary to the President of the Municipality. Confident, energetic, anointed, a woman who has all the information, a woman for all time, resourceful and shrewd.

movie.title: Psi laju, vetar nosi
movie.description: A tale of people who live outside the big city who get mixed up in hilarious situations and events.

movie.title: U klinču
movie.description: At the turning point of his life, 20-year-old Aljoša Kovač is trying to strike a balance between the expectations of his father Velja, the ambitions of his mother Mira, his own hard-to-achieve passion for music, and a love that is nearing its inevitable end.

movie.title: Složna braća
movie.description: Taking place just after the end of Bosnian War, the series is mostly set in a kafana named Složna braća owned by Halimić brothers and located on a small patch of UN-controlled territory (covering 0.0657 km2) not claimed by any of the three warring sides. Serbs, Bosniaks, and Croats, otherwise very hostile to each other following a ferocious civil war, regularly visit the said kafana in no man's land in order to arrange mutual black market activities (weapons and food trade, oil and cigarette smuggling, etc.). When the word gets around about an important weapons shipment passing through the territory that can supposedly completely change the division of power in the Balkans, the place becomes a lively hub of espionage, deal making, and skulduggery.

movie.title: Koža
movie.description:
“Koža” je priča o muzičaru, bivšem narkomanu i dileru droge kome je ime Slobodan Milošević i koji, nakon višegodišnjeg izdržavanja zatvorske kazne zbog šverca dvadeset kilograma kokaina u Holandiju, biva pušten na slobodu iz zatvora u Hagu.
U povratku preko Beograda u njegov rodni grad Banja Luku, u Slobodanu oživljavaju reminiscencije na njegov pređašnji život: vreme studiranja na muzičkoj akademiji u Hagu, rat u bivšoj Jugoslaviji u kojem mu ginu roditelji, period života u Beogradu devedesetih godina prošlog veka obeležen likovima iz kriminalnog i narkomanskog miljea.
Dolaskom u rodni grad Slobodan pokušava da pronađe svoje mesto u društvu i sistemu koji je odavno promenjen i u kojem vladaju neka nova pravila koja su njemu nepoznata. U isto vreme on se suočava i sa likovima i događajima iz prošlosti koji će ga iznova promeniti i staviti pred njega dilemu – da li ka pročišćenju i daljem životu krenuti putem osvete i isterivanja vlastite pravde, ili putem oprosta i isceljenja duše?

movie.title: Santa Maria della Salute
movie.description: Tells the story of famous poet Laza Kostic and relationship with Lenka Dundjerski, much younger girl and daughter of his friend.

movie.title: Miris kiše na Balkanu
movie.description: Trials and tribulations of a Jewish family from Sarajevo during turbulent times between 1914 and 1945.

movie.title: Senke nad Balkanom
movie.description: Serija je smještena između dva svjetska rata u Kraljevini Jugoslaviji i prati priču dva inspektora beogradske policije, koji, neposredno pred Atentat u Narodnoj skupštini 1928. pokušavaju riješiti misteriju ritualnih ubistava koja potresaju javnost.

movie.title: Kosti
movie.description: Doktorica Temperance Brennan vrhunska je forenzična antropologinja, zaposlena u uglednom institutu Jeffersonian, koju policija i druge snage reda često zovu u pomoć pri onim slučajevima ubojstava u kojima su standardne metode identificiranja žrtava nedovoljne. Naime, Temperanceina specijalnost njezina je nesvakidašnja sposobnost čitanja tragova u žrtvinim izgorenim, uništenim ili teže oštećenim kostima. Brennan najčešće surađuje sa specijalnim agentom Seeleyem Boothom, članom posebnog FBI-jeva tima za istraživanje ubojstava.

movie.title: "Više od igre"
movie.description: The story follows a ten-year period before WW2 in a fictional town of Gradina, Serbia and its residents, which went through the turbulent events like the Great Depression and the rise of fascism. But the most important segment of the story revolves around rivalry between two city's football clubs - Radnicki and Gradjanski.

movie.title: "Testament"
movie.description: The series is a modern-day reimagining of the Book of Acts that follows the early followers of Jesus in an alternate, modern era. A resurrection sparks a new movement that turns the world upside down, spreading hope amid chaos. As the followers risk everything to preach the good news, the Temple races to silence them before the oppressive Imperium regime retaliates. But public miracles, unburied secrets, and fractured loyalties force both sides to confront the true cost of their choices.

movie.title: Čizmaši
movie.description: Moćna lirska priča o naredniku bivše Vojske Jugoslavije Žiki Kurjaku, od detinjstva u domu rudara, preko vojnih dana, pa sve do teške depresije, zatvora i metropolitanskog ludila. Kurjak, personifikacija ljudske dobrote, koja je oslabljena i uznemirena, kao stara i ornamentirana u bolnici, detaljno govori o svom životu. Kroz ovu mučnu priču o naredniku Ziki Kurjaku i njegovom životu ulepšavaju se neke krucijalne istorijske okolnosti 20. veka, kao i sudbina herojske srpske vojske koja nakon ujedinjenja postaje deo novog sistema i koja sistem lagano uništava ostavljajući pojedince da se pojedinačno bore za njega i sprečavaju neizbežno propadanje.

movie.title: "Sudbine"
movie.description: Two babies, Aleksa and Luka are switched at the hospital accidentally. Thirty years later, Aleksa is a rich and successful businessman while Luka is poor and barely gets by. When the nurse who switched the two of them tells them what she had done, their lives change completely.

movie.title: Mama i tata se igraju rata
movie.description: Follow heroes who are on the threshold of middle age, focusing on that moment of their lives when their "youth" and all the illusions they clung to finally give way to decisions and obligations that require maturity.

movie.title: "Beograd"
movie.description: Paša (Miloš Biković) postaje vlasnik eminentnog Hotela Beograd, darivan od strane njegove tetke. Unatoč početnom nezanimanju za poslovanje hotela, uskoro upada u velike nevolje prouzrokovane milijunskim štetama koje nanosi. Kako bi spasio Hotel Beograd iz očajničke situacije, nalazi se prisiljen oženiti kćerkom lokalnog mafijaša (Ljubomir Bandović), što mu dodatno komplicira život. Međutim, stvari se zahuktavaju kada neočekivano ponovno sretne svoju staru ljubav, Ruskinju Dašu (Jelisaveta Orasanin). Njihov ponovni susret budi stare osjećaje, ali Pašin trenutni brak i obaveze prema Hotelu Beograd stoje kao velika prepreka njihovoj ljubavi. Daša se nađe rastrgana između svojih osjećaja i Pašine komplicirane situacije. Sudbina njihove veze ovisi ne samo o njihovim osobnim izborima, već i o mračnim silama koje upravljaju Hotelom Beograd. Hoće li pronaći put jedno do drugoga ili će Hotel Beograd ostati mjesto njihovih neostvarenih snova, tek treba vidjeti.

movie.title: Kamiondžije d.o.o.
movie.description: Priča počinje slučajnim susretom Žiće, bivšeg šofera, a potom bibliotekara u maloj seoskoj školi u okolini Uba, i Baje, vozača autobusa u gradskom saobraćajnom preduzeću u Ubu.

movie.title: "Odbrojavanje"
movie.description: Zaviri u trening-kampove i privatne živote Jakea Paula i Mikea Tysona, koji se pripremaju za nezaboravan boksački meč teškaša uživo 15. studenoga.

movie.title: "Krugovi"
movie.description: U slikovitom gradiću Kalkan, iza mirne fasade krije se mračna tajna stara decenijama. Dve porodice, zarobljene u spirali sukoba, ponovo se suočavaju licem u lice, a svaki njihov potez otvara rane iz prošlosti koje nikada nisu zalečene. Kalkanski krugovi nisu samo priča o osveti i rivalstvu, već i o ljubavi, izdaji i potrazi za istinom koja menja sve. Kako vreme otkucava, postaje jasno da je konačno došao trenutak da se razreši ono što je generacijama skrivano. Intrige, napetost i neizvesnost čine da Kalkanski krugovi drže gledaoce prikovane za ekran, dok sudbine junaka ulaze u vrtlog iz kojeg nema izlaza. Samo će najhrabriji uspeti da izađu iz Kalkanskih krugova neokrznuti.

movie.title: Selo gori, a baba se češlja
Greh njene majke
movie.description: A modest Serbian girl from the 1930s loses both her parents in a year. She gets abducted by a beautiful stranger who forces her to marry him. For her he remains a mystery she is trying to solve throughout the series which is based on the novel of the same name my Mir-Jam.

movie.title: Salaš u malom ritu
movie.description: Salaš u Malom Ritu is a Serbian TV series, that was very popular in former Yugoslavia, base on eponymous novel of Arsen Diklić, with Slavko Štimac in main role. The show spawns two TV films, Salaš u Malom Ritu and Zimovanje u Jakobsfeldu.

movie.title: Ravna gora
movie.description: Ravna Gora tells story of events after April War 1941. Serbia with accent on the Chetnic-Partisan conflict, at the beginning of World War II

movie.title: Kamiondžije
movie.description: Čuvene Kamiondžije su jugoslovenska TV serija, koja govori o životu dvojice šofera, legendarnim Paji i Jaretu. Jarić Živadin - Jare, živi veoma skromno u svojoj maloj kući sa svojom mnogočlanom porodicom, zbog toga na posao dolazi često veoma neispavan. Njegov partner za volanom, Pavle Čutura - Paja, je pravi šofer koji živi za kafanu dobro piće i jelo, ali je zbog takvog života ostao neženja i bez porodice. Ova dva suprotna karaktera, bojažljivi Jare i neustrašivi Paja, dele isto radno mesto, šofersku kabinu kamiona šestotonca. Paja i Jare, su zajedno pohađali večernju školu, hvatali lopove, odgovarali pred vlasti jedan za drugog, vraćali dugove i dugo godina bili primer pravog prijateljstva.

movie.title: Ranjeni orao
movie.description: Ranjeni orao was a Serbian television show produced in 2008 and aired on RTS1 during late 2008 and early 2009. The 17 episode series is based on the 1936 novel "Ranjeni orao" by Serbian author Mir Jam. The show had unprecedented success with the last episode averaging over 3 million viewers, making it the most watched Serbian television series ever made.

movie.title: Povratak otpisanih
movie.description: In Summer of 1944 Prle and Tihi, young yet veteran resistance fighters, together with Joca, old and moody radio-operator, are sent by Partisans to Belgrade, the Yugoslav capital still under Nazi occupation. As victorious Partisan forces approach, Prle, Tihi and Joca must continue their underground work in order to prepare the city for liberation.

movie.title: Vojna Akademija
movie.description: Throughout the series follows the stories, lives and adventures of a group of military cadets after their reception at a military academy where starting with education for military pilots.

movie.title: Ubice mog oca
movie.description: U napetoj kriminalističkoj drami Ubice mog oca mladi inspektor beogradske policije Aleksandar Jakovljević nalazi se pred svojim najizazovnijim slučajem - ubojstvom kćeri uglednog poslovnog čovjeka. Unatoč vlastitim problemima i problematičnom ponašanju, Aleksandar se ne predaje lako, već zaranja duboko u svaki segment života ubijene djevojke tragajući za istinom koja je mnogima nepoželjna. Serija Ubice mog oca prikazuje složenost istrage u kojoj svaki trag može biti ključan, a svaka otkrivena tajna vodi Aleksandra bliže opasnosti koja prijeti da zataška pravu priču iza ubojstva. Ubice mog oca majstorski spaja elemente psihološke drame i kriminalističke istrage nudeći gledateljima uvid u mračne tajne društva i korupciju koja seže duboko u temelje sistema. Kroz seriju gledatelji postaju svjedoci ne samo Aleksandrove profesionalne odanosti i upornosti, već i njegove osobne borbe, čineći Ubice mog oca serijom koja zadržava napetost od prve do posljednje epizode.

movie.title: Otpisani
movie.description: Televizijska serija „Otpisani“ bazirana je na istoimenoj knjizi i zasniva se na spoju izmišljenih i istinitih događaja iz vremena ilegalnog otpora okupatoru, tokom okupacije Beograda za vreme Drugog svetskog rata, od 1941. do 1945. godine. Iako dosta izmenjeni, mnogi delovi serije su nastali prema stvarnim događajima, kao što su - spasavanje Aleksandra Rankovića iz zatvorske bolnice u Vidinskoj ulici, jula 1941; paljenje garaže u Grobljanskoj ulici, avgusta 1941; ubistvo agenata Đorđa Kosmajca i Obrada Zalada u ulici Cara Uroša, marta 1942; rad ilegalne štamparije u Beogradu, koja je funkcionisala na dve lokacije 1941-1944. i dr.

movie.title: Prvaci sveta
movie.description:
Osnovna linija priče smještena je u 2001. godinu, ali nas radnja, kroz sjećanja glavnih junaka, vraća i u prošla vremena kada je tadašnja Jugoslavija ostvarila izuzetne uspjehe na svjetskoj košarkaškoj sceni, sa naglaskom na prvu titulu prvaka svijeta 1970. godine u Ljubljani. U avgustu 2001. godine u Istanbulu reprezentacija osvaja novo evropsko zlato, ali samo dva mjeseca kasnije umire Nebojša Popović.
Serijal od prvih 12 epizoda odvija se u nekoliko različitih vremena - priča počinje 2001. godine u vrijeme odvijanja Evropskog košarkaškog prvenstva u Turskoj kada je naša reprezentacija osvojila važno zlato ali i prati sve one događaje koji su doveli do osvajanja prve zlatne medalje naše reprezentacije u Ljubljani 1970. godine.

movie.title: Nobelovac
movie.description: Serija od osam epizoda prati život književnika Ive Andrića tokom nekoliko meseci u jesen i zimu 1961. godine, od trenutka kada je saznao da je dobio Nobelovu nagradu do povratka sa ceremonije Šva dodele, preko. Svaka od epizoda ima dva paralelna toka naracije: jedan, vezan za 1961. godinu, uporedo Andrićeve pripreme za odlazak u Stokholm, i drugi, subjektivni skok povratak u prošlost. Andrićev pogled na ključne trenutke društvenog života, koji su gotovo uvek bili i ključni trenuci zemlje u kojoj je živeo i živi, susrete i odluke koje je doneo punu vrednost, sumnju i preispitivanje. Kroz osam epizoda otkrivaju se i prate najvažnije, poznate i jedne manje poznate, staze kojima je Andrić hodao, lica koja su ga okruživala i predeli u kojima je boravio tokom zime 1961. godine i tokom života.

movie.title: Crni Gruja
movie.description: Izbijanje srpskog ustanka protiv Turaka postavlja scenu za uzbudljivu priču. U ovom istorijskom kontekstu, susrećemo se sa korumpiranim lokalnim knezom koji se bori sa željom da pronađe put ka boljem životu. Sudar moći, pohlepe, neispunjenih čežnji, ljubavi i mržnje odvija se na pozadini balkanskih događaja 19. veka. Likovi, živopisno prikazani, snalaze se u borbi za slobodu od turske okupacije. Da li su oni poslednja prepreka koja može spasiti Evropu od opasnosti koja dolazi sa Istoka? Odgovor leži u ovoj duhovitoj komediji inspirisanoj stvarnim događajima, dragulju koji prevazilazi vreme i prostor.

movie.title: Jutro će promeniti sve
movie.description:
Ovo je priča o mladim ljudima koji su prešli tridesetu, završili sa školovanjem, nisu oformili porodicu, nemaju stalne poslove i još uvek tragaju za sobom i „svojim mestom“ u svetu...
U raskoraku između rane mladosti koja im izmiče i odraslog doba, naši likovi pokušavaju da redefinišu svoje prijateljske i emotivne odnose i shvate „kuda dalje“.
Kroz borbu sa životnim izazovima jedne generacije, serija pokušava i da dočara duh Beograda danas: govori o onima koji žive u njemu, onima koji iz njega odlaze, ali i onima koji mu se ponovo vraćaju...

movie.title: Selo gori, a baba se češlja
movie.description: Selo gori, a baba se češlja is a television series in Serbia. First aired in 2007, the show quickly gained national fame with episodes in its third season averaging approximately 2.9 million viewers. The show was aired on RTS1.

movie.title: Bilo jednom u Srbiji
movie.description: During and after World War II, two young men and two young ladies had very different destinies. Dine was taken to Paris by the Allies where he learned how beautiful life can be under the bright lights of a Metropolis. Cone, after suffering amnesia, was taken to Manchester, the industrial capital of the world where thick fabric smoke taught him how hard work pays off. Euphoric of the victory in the War and infected by the spirit of freedom and progress which they felt on the Front, they come home to their run-down hometown of Leskovac. Dine returns to his now non-existent movie theater and Cone to his fiancee, who after 5 long years of waiting has unwillingly promised her hand to a war profiteer. Cone will try to win-back his old lover, whereas Dine will seek a new one. And so begins the fight between the "old" and the "new" in every respect; since for great deeds, only a little bit of true love is necessary.

movie.title: Montevideo, Bog te video!
movie.description: Romantična nogometna priča u produkciji „Intermedia Networka“, debitantski je redateljski prvijenac legendarnog glumca Dragana Bjelogrlića, ispričan kroz seriju od tri sezone, u kojoj se upoznajemo s nastajanjem prvog nogometnog tima Kraljevine Jugoslavije. Prva nacionalna nogometna momčad odlazi na Prvo svjetsko prvenstvo u Montevideo, u Urugvaj, koje se održava od 13. do 30. srpnja 1930. i na kojem sudjeluje trinaest momčadi - četiri iz Europe, od kojih je jedna bila Jugoslavija, te devet iz Južne i Sjeverne Amerike.

movie.title: Poziv
movie.description: Detektiv njujorške policije u duhovnoj potrazi za pravdom, oslanja se na vlastitu vjeru u ljudskost kada naizgled rutinske istrage pođu po zlu.

movie.title: Božićni ustanak
movie.description: TV series about the end of the First World War, the loss of statehood, and the Christmas Uprising - the most tragic events in Montenegro's history. The story is told through love story and family relations in that period in Montenegro.

movie.title: Đekna jos nije umrla,
movie.description: The comic adventures of a Montenegrin family that live in an isolated village high in the mountains, eternally waiting for their son to come back from his studies in Munich.

movie.title: MS
movie.description: Ms! was a Canadian current affairs television series which aired on CBC Television in 1973.

Pop Cira i Pop Spira
movie.description: "Priest Ćira and Priest Spira" is a Yugoslavian television mini-series from 1983 based on Stevan Sremac's story of the same name. It's a humorous adaptation directed by Soja Jovanović, who also made an earlier film version in 1957. The story revolves around the rivalry between two village priests when a young teacher is set to marry the daughter of only one of them.

movie.title: PUSTOLOV
movie.description: Milan 'Lane' Gutović play the adventurer, who in a funny way tells children about his safari endeavours for the bedtime.

movie.title: Vojnici
movie.description: More or less happy adventures of a Yugoslav People's Army unit, a friendly batch that couldn't be more ethnically diverse.

movie.title: Ljubav Na Seoski Nacin
movie.description: Milorad is a young villager grown enough to marry, but his uncle Gvozden and grandpa Paun want to arrange him a marriage with Radmila, a girl from a wealthy family. He escapes to the big town, refusing to take part in it, but his adventure with a girl named Rozika ends up and he finds himself back in his village again.

movie.title: Jedne letnje noci
movie.description: Krinka and Lola Brankovic are two sisters in their early twenties, both very attractive and interesting although completely different. Krinka is reserved; she likes daydreaming and is not much interested in loving relationships. Lola is her total opposite she remained widow young but still has a lot of desire for life and likes meeting different men. One summer, the two of them together with their mother go on a boat trip to Venice, and the island of Rab. That summer, Krinkas encounter with Dubravko, and Lolas with Zarko will forever change their lives.

movie.title: Branio sam Mladu Bosnu
movie.description: When Gavrilo Princip killed Franz Ferdinand , Austrian future king , the World War I began. What will Gavrilo Princip do? He has to choose , hard jail untill death, or hanging. There are so much things happening in Bosnia.

movie.title: Samac u braku
movie.description: Uspešni mladi advokat Radmilo već je godinama zaljubljen u lepu Beograđanku Ljiljanu. Uprkos tome što je najpoželjniji neženja svog malog grada, on odoleva svim primamljivim bračnim ponudama, i ostaje odlučan u nameri da baš Ljiljana bude njegova žena. Sa druge strane, Ljiljana sanjari o braku sa Momčilom koji u presudnom trenutku pokazuje svoje pravo lice i odbija da se oženi Ljiljanom, ismevajući je. Tako ona iz čistog prkosa pristaje da se uda za Radmila, i oni zajedno odlaze u palanku, gde ih očekuju mnogi radoznali i sumnjičavi pogledi.

movie.title: Sesir profesora Koste Vujica
movie.description: The incredible story of good-hearted and eccentric Professor Kosta Vujic who, in the 19th century, taught some of the greatest minds of that era. Among his students were Mihailo Petrovic - Mika Alas, Jovan Cvijic, Pavle Popovic, Jasa Prodanovic, Milorad Mitrovic, Ljubomir Stojanovic and others who later became academics, teachers, politicians... The TV Show is based on the best seller novel by Milovan Vitezovic.

movie.title: Iz X u X domaca serija (
Drug Crni u NOB
movie.description: In Yugoslavija during WWII in pub Drug Crni(Comrade Black) and his friends fights againts Nazi.
